sentences.en: What is asserted without evidence may be dismissed without evidence.
sentences.zh: 没有证据的情况下所断言的内容可能也会因为缺乏证据而被驳回。

sentences.en: What can be asserted without evidence can be dismissed without evidence.
sentences.zh: 没有证据支持的说法可以同样在缺乏证据的情况下被否定。

sentences.en: She persisted in asserting that she had not taken the brooch.
sentences.zh: 她坚持声称自己并未拿走那枚胸针。

phrases.zh: assert himself - 坚持自己的观点或立场
how to assert - 如何断言或坚持
needed to assert - 需要站出来坚持

senses.zh: 断言，肯定地说出：declare, forcefully, aggressively
